message.reasoning_content:
Record 2-3 high-risk in-scope claims. Top: LEVELS=0 single-chunk double count. Also the tree-sweep for non-power-of-two chunks (padded with identity, but the up-sweep in _exclusive_chunks... actually padded is always power of two so C is pow2. The risk about C=4/8 tree sweep. Also padding identity in _block_carries: for lane < CHUNKS real summary, else identity — fine. Note: for N<=8, chunks=1, padded=1, LEVELS=0. _block_carries: a keeps summary, exclusive_chunks resets... line 41-43 only resets lane C-1=0 to identity! Wait, lane==C-1 resets to identity. For C=1, lane 0 is C-1, so it's reset to identity, loops skipped, so carry = identity∘initial. Hmm — actually line 41-43 resets lane C-1 to identity — that's the standard Blelloch trick (clear the last). So single-chunk may be fine! But for padded > chunks? For lane == C-1 the summary of last real chunk... fine. Actually the reset at line 41-43 zeroes lane C-1's accumulated total (which is the inclusive total of everything) — but lanes > C-1... For C>1, after up-sweep lane C-1 holds total of all C chunks including padding. Reset to identity. Down-sweep then propagates exclusive prefixes. Seems standard. But for single chunk C=1: up-sweep skipped, lane 0 holds summary (total of chunk 0), reset to identity — so carry = initial only. OK, correct. Hmm, so describer's top risk is actually handled by lines 41-43. Still testable — record as claim; probe will decide.

But subtle: padded >= chunks. When chunks < padded, lanes >= chunks have identity (from masked load). Up-sweep gathers those; identity neutral; fine. Exclusive carry for lanes >= chunks garbage but unused (only chunks carry read).

Second claim: _exclusive_chunks down-sweep bookkeeping for C=4/8 — check: at each level, right = end of segment; down-sweep sets lane==left to prefix (pa), lane==right to pa∘la. But lanes strictly between left and right keep up-sweep values... In standard Blelloch this works recursively. Actually wait, there's a subtlety: down-sweep at level processes every segment; but the compose at line 55 is compose(prefix_p, left_l) — the right child's new value should be p ∘ left's value. Looks standard. But concern: at level where segment spans whole array, lane==left gets pa which is identity (fine).

Third claim: _local_scan summary store uses a of last lane when BLOCK-1 masked step: for N not multiple of 8, last chunk's lane BLOCK-1 corresponds to step >= N, but associative_scan of identity-padded gives the same total — summary is inclusive total including identity padding, fine.

Fourth: _block_carries stores carry for ALL padded lanes, but carry tensor is torch.empty and only chunks used — fine.

Another genuine risk: tl.associative_scan with a tuple of 6 tensors and a multi-arg combine function — Triton support. And tl.gather axis semantics. Also the _apply_prefix loads prefix at masked steps with default 0 — but stores masked, fine.

Actually a real concern: In _local_scan, prefix stored for steps < N uses pos = row*N + step, but for masked steps nothing stored — fine. In _block_carries, masked loads default identity for lane>=chunks — fine.

One more: LEVELS = padded.bit_length()-1. For padded=1, bit_length=1, LEVELS=0. For padded=4, LEVELS=2. OK.

So record 3 claims: (1) single-chunk N<=8 exclusive carry (probe decides; describer flagged but lines 41-43 may fix — still testable), (2) down-sweep bookkeeping for C=4/8 nontrivial, (3) tl.associative_scan/tl.gather Triton 3.4 semantics for 6-tuple int64 scan. All in_scope since N 1..32 in contract.
